hypothesis: Image contribution is greater for high visual-consistency customers.
history: Before test_start; most recent 50 distinct products; dominant product type with at least 5 distinct products.
consistency_measure: Mean pairwise cosine similarity of Marqo image embeddings.
grouping: Bottom and top thirds within product type and history-size band; minimum 30 customers per group.
evaluation_plan: Non-repurchase test purchases in the customer's dominant product type; customer-average Recall@300; C2 minus C4; compare high minus low within strata.
